title: The Year Dunzo's Paydays Kept Moving
conflicts: FY23: loss ₹1,801.8 crore on revenue ₹226.6 crore (Outlook Business, Inc42 body, MediaNama) vs ₹1,748 crore on ₹206.5 crore (Inc42 summary), and MediaNama's ₹266 crore revenue (likely typo); story uses about ₹1,800 crore and ₹227 crore. Layoffs in 2023: about 30% / 300 people in April (Reuters, Inc42) vs more than 1,300 in the year (Outlook); story uses the dated 30%. Total raised: $485m (Inc42, Legal Era) vs about $500m (TNM); not used. Founding year 2014 vs 2015; not given. Velvin's first plea dated Nov 2023 (Outlook) vs Sep 2024 (Inc42); story gives only the NCLT admission date, 6 August 2025 (Legal Era).
notes: Episode centred on the September 2023 town hall and the year of salary deferrals, with the January 2022 Reliance-led round as the bet and the 2024-25 aftermath (75% layoffs, Biswas to Flipkart, Reliance write-off, NCLT admission). No court or regulator finding of fault exists, so no blame is assigned; the claim that Biswas was focused on fundraising while co-founders handled staff is an unnamed ET source and attributed. The slate's year was 2024; the documented episode is 2023 with aftermath to 2025. Quote stance complicates (Saadi's root and tree). Biswas's reported 20 months without salary is only in a blocked YourStory page and is not used.
